summary: Entry week: establish movement habits, all Z1-Z2, lower-body and core strength only, no intensity — build the aerobic floor and protect the shoulder

steps.description: Z1 walk-to-jog, <145 bpm, hip circles and leg swings
Z2 aerobic, 146-162 bpm, conversational pace, do not let HR drift above 162
Z1 slow jog or brisk walk, let HR fall below 130 bpm

sessions.name: Sweet spot introduction — 2x8 min
sessions.focus: First Zone 3 sweet spot stimulus, sub-threshold aerobic development

steps.description: Z1-Z2 spin, build from 80W to 130W, cadence 85-95 rpm
Z3 sweet spot, 163-172 bpm reference, cadence 85-92 rpm, RPE 6/10, smooth and sustained
Z1 easy spin recovery between efforts, let HR fall back toward 140
Z1 easy spin, HR falling toward 120 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Lower body & core — build progression
sessions.focus: Progressive lower-body strength and core stability, shoulder fully protected
sessions.notes: 3 rounds: 12x goblet squat 22kg, 10x RDL 22kg, 8x TRX Bulgarian split squat per leg (foot in TRX strap — no shoulder load), 15x banded lateral walk each direction (medium band), 8x dead bug per side (3s eccentric), 30s side plank per side (sub forearm plank if shoulder discomfort). Rest 60-75s between rounds. Warm-up: 10x BW squat, 10x glute bridge, 10x leg swing each side, 30s hip flexor hold each side. Cool-down: 45s hip flexor each side, 45s pigeon/figure-4 each side, 30s hamstring each side.

steps.description: Bodyweight squat x10, glute bridge x10, leg swings x10 each side, hip flexor hold 30s each side

3 rounds of circuit: goblet squat 12x22kg, RDL 10x22kg, TRX Bulgarian split squat 8x/leg, banded lateral walk 15 steps each direction, dead bug 8x/side, side plank 30s/side. Rest 60-75s between rounds.
Static stretch: hip flexors, glutes (pigeon or figure-4), hamstrings — 45s each hold

summary: First quality stimulus: introduce sweet spot cycling (Z3), extend Z2 run discipline, progress strength circuit with Bulgarian split squat and dead bug — shoulder remains protected

sessions.name: Easy aerobic run
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic base, HR ceiling discipline at 162 bpm

sessions.name: Sweet spot introduction — 2x8 min
sessions.focus: First Z3 sustained effort, sub-threshold aerobic development, 2x8 min at 142-165W

sessions.name: Lower body & core — build progression
sessions.focus: Bulgarian split squat, RDL, dead bug progression — shoulder protected throughout

summary: Consolidate build: extend sweet spot cycling to 3x8 min, introduce a short Z3 tempo running segment, progress strength loading on RDL and add single-leg deadlift for balance — first light upper body assessment if shoulder allows

sessions.name: Aerobic run with tempo finish
sessions.focus: 20 min Z2 + 5 min Z3 tempo introduction at end of run — first taste of running quality

sessions.name: Sweet spot build — 3x8 min
sessions.focus: Progress to 3 efforts at 142-168W, same duration, one more rep — aerobic power ceiling rises

sessions.name: Lower body & core — load progression
sessions.focus: RDL to 22kg for 12 reps, add single-leg RDL for balance, progress dead bug to reach with leg extension — cautious shoulder reassessment

summary: Recovery week: cut volume ~40%, all sessions easy Z1-Z2 only, strength circuit reduced to 2 rounds — let the adaptation from 3 weeks of build actually land before the next block begins

sessions.name: Easy recovery run
sessions.focus: Pure Z1-Z2, no tempo, shorter duration — active recovery and movement maintenance only

sessions.name: Easy aerobic spin
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 only, 88-141W, no sweet spot — flush legs, keep aerobic stimulus alive without fatigue

sessions.name: Lower body & core — recovery circuit
sessions.focus: 2 rounds only, bodyweight or light loads, prioritise mobility and movement quality over load
